senses.gloss: m. (הגן, v. preced. wds.; v. meanings of Arab. stem haġan in Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 423ᵃ) young camel, or dromedary. Pl. הוֹגְנִין, הוֹגְנֵי.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 60:6">Targ. Is. LX, 6</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>תגרי</he>, h. text <he>בכרי</he>).
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 9:1">Targ. II Chr. IX, 1</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:5">Y. Ḥag. II, beg. 77ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:21-26">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>נפישין … משכי דה׳</he> many old camels are laden with the hides of the young ones (many old men survive the young).
